root: ^Lady: Yes? Can I help you, young man?

c-0:
^You: Good evening, madam. Might I have a moment of your time? I believe the ship may be in danger.

^Lady: (warms slightly) My, what excellent manners. Very well — you have my attention. Though I must say, 'danger' seems rather unlikely on a ship such as this. Though now that you mention it... I did hear one of the officers muttering about the cold tonight. Peculiar, that. (walks off, more thoughtful than dismissive)
c-1:
^You: Hey, listen — we've got a big problem, okay?

^Lady: (visibly taken aback) I beg your pardon? Do you know how to address a lady properly? (walks off immediately, offended)
